overview: Based on the published agenda, the Kronenwetter Parks Committee was scheduled to meet to address multiple park development and fundraising initiatives, including components for Buska Park improvements, an upcoming 5K fundraiser event, capital project costs, and consideration of a zipline installation at Friendship Park.

agenda.item: Approval of August 17, 2026 Parks Committee Meeting Minutes

discussions.item: Buska Park Fundraising Components (Bricks, Signage, Etc.)
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss new fundraising components for Buska Park, including the implementation of bricks, signage, and other related elements. This item was set for consideration as new business to advance the park development initiative.

discussions.item: September 12, 2026 Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser Event
discussions.body: The committee was expected to review details and logistics for the scheduled Buska Park 5K Run/Walk Fundraiser Event set for September 12, 2026. This item was set to address ongoing coordination and planning for the community fundraising event.

The committee was scheduled to review and consider costs associated with capital improvement projects. This agenda item was set to address financial planning and budget implications for planned park infrastructure upgrades.

The committee was expected to consider a list of quick fix maintenance and improvement items for village parks. This item was set for review as part of ongoing park maintenance and operational planning.

The committee was scheduled to discuss the proposed zipline installation at Friendship Park. This item was set for consideration regarding the feasibility, design, and implementation of this recreational amenity.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, with discretionary extension by the Chief Presiding Officer.
